fixes: Reference is mostly a soft, near-streakless photo blur. Only the bottom-right quadrant shows radial motion streaks fanning toward the corner. Ours has hard diagonal streak lines across the whole frame, top-left included.

Our teal-green blobs are about 15 small, evenly spaced, crisp ellipses, like polka dots. The reference has a few large, irregular, very soft teal-green masses: one clump in the left-centre (x ~15-60%, y ~25-65%) and one in the bottom-left. Upper right and the right edge have almost none.

Colour placement: the reference is lavender/periwinkle across the top-left two thirds and warm pink-beige only in the bottom-right, where tan/brown streaks sit in the corner. Ours puts pink bands across the upper right and middle, and adds small orange-pink dots that the reference doesn't have.

The bottom dark mass should be a saturated oxblood/maroon core (centre-right, y ~80-100%) with a navy-violet fringe above it. Ours is a muted grey-navy smudge in the bottom-right corner with almost no red.

The left edge needs a dark oxblood-to-navy mass from y ~10% to ~55%, with a blue-violet streak below it at ~55-60%. Our left edge goes pale grey-blue below ~50% with no blue-violet band. Our top-left corner is near-black, but the reference's is navy blue, with the oxblood sitting lower.

Our prism fringe is a crisp, visible rainbow hairline running diagonally through the upper-left dark mass (~15-55% x, 10-45% y). The reference's chromatic edge is faint and diffuse, only a soft cyan/magenta tint where the dark mass meets the pale band at ~0-40% x, ~45-55% y.

Streak curvature is wrong. The reference streaks are nearly straight lines fanning from a vanishing point beyond the top-right corner: almost horizontal at the top, ~30-35 degrees down-left at the bottom-left. Ours bend into concave arcs that sag on the right and flatten to horizontal at the left edge.

The reference's secondary dark band runs diagonally from the centre-right (~60% x, 60% y) to the bottom-right corner. Ours sits as a roughly horizontal dark lobe at the right edge around 55-70% y and doesn't reach the bottom-right corner.

The reference has dense fine striation everywhere, plus a brighter streak cluster under the top-right dark area (x 20-60%, y 5-20%) and a brighter bottom-left corner. Our lower-left half is a flat, even mid-grey with sparse thin dark lines.

The pale band entering from the left (~40-65% y) should have a red/pink upper edge and a blue/cyan lower edge (two-sided chromatic split), with a near-white core. Ours shows a soft pink-yellow-green rainbow smear and a dimmer, greyer core.

The upper-left area (y ~5-35%) should be saturated blue-violet with distinct parallel fine streak lines and a bright blue rim just under the pale top-right region. Ours is a greyish, muddy violet with few visible lines and only a faint blue rim on the right.

The reference's dark oxblood mass is deep maroon and centred at ~55-80% x, 45-80% y. The bottom-right corner fades to a lighter mauve-grey and the bottom-left has a violet-blue band. Ours is browner, pushes the darkest tone into the bottom-right corner, and lacks the blue band at the bottom left.

Ours is built from rigid, straight, parallel bands with even widths. In the reference the bands are slightly wavy and uneven: the white band is widest at the left-middle, and the right-side dark navy streak swells into a blob around 65-80% x, 55-75% y.

The right edge of the reference is a lighter mid-blue between ~25% and ~65% y, with the navy streak running inside it. Ours has the navy band running cleanly to the bottom-right corner, plus a separate thin pale-blue stripe at the far right (~95% x, 55-80% y) that the reference doesn't have.

The dark navy top-left corner is larger and more saturated in the reference: it reaches ~35% x along the top and ~30% y down the left edge, with a soft blue gradient into the white. Ours is a smaller, steeper wedge.

The dark-red diagonal line in the reference is soft and short: about 60-70% x across 15-40% y, a blurred thick line. Ours is crisper, more saturated, and much longer, running from ~32% x at mid-height to ~80% x at the top edge.
The top-left corner of the reference is red-orange, with a pale yellow streak at ~15-45% x, 20-45% y. Our whole top-left is a flat pale peach/tan with no red-orange corner.

The reference has a strong red-orange band at the bottom right (x 70-100%, y 70-100%) and a red bottom-left corner. Our bottom right is pale peach/yellow streaks, and our red sits only along the bottom-left/bottom-centre.

Our streaks curve too much into a fan converging at the right-middle edge, with lower streaks bending visibly upward. In the reference the streaks are gently curved, almost straight, sweeping slightly down-left in the top half and slightly up-right in the bottom half.

The reference's deep cobalt fills a larger top-right region: about 55% across the top and down to ~35% on the right edge, with a second darker diagonal band at the right edge around 30-45% y. Ours has a smaller dark corner and a thin dark line cluster at ~70% y on the right that the reference doesn't have.

The reference's pale whitish streaks are clustered in two zones: upper-left (y 10-30%) and lower-left (y 65-95%), as soft wisps. Ours spreads many thin, similar-looking light/dark hairlines evenly over the whole left and centre, which reads busier and more regular.
The palette is too saturated and peachy. The reference is a more muted sand/tan-amber with burnt orange. Our pale areas are bright apricot instead of the reference's desaturated cream-beige.
The reference is covered in fine, dense, thin streak striation along the diagonal. Ours is mostly broad soft blurred bands with little fine-line texture.

Highlight placement: the reference has a narrow cream highlight streak at the right edge (~15-25% y) and one entering from the left at ~45-55% y. Ours has large, soft apricot blobs in the centre-right (60-95% x, 25-45% y) and the upper-left, and no distinct narrow highlight streaks.

In the reference, green streaks interleave with blue across most of the frame: green dominates the upper ~55% on the left and ~40% on the right, and green streaks still cut through the lower half (around 55-70% y on the left, a green wisp at 85% y). Ours keeps green to a top band of about 25-30% and leaves a large, flat, streakless blue area across the middle-right.

The reference's streaks fan out radially from the left-centre, steep up-right at the top and flatter lower down, with many fine streaks. Ours has a few broad, soft, almost parallel bands with a curved green/blue boundary.

The bottom of the reference (y 75-100%) is periwinkle/lavender-blue. Ours is a muted grey-teal there. The reference's dark green blob sits at the left edge around 65-75% y; ours is higher, at ~50-60% y.

The reference has warm yellow-olive streaks in the upper-centre/right (x 55-90%, y 15-40%) and lime-yellow lines lower-left (y 65-75%). Ours is almost purely cool green and blue-grey, with no yellow-olive.

Ours has one long, prominent pale streak from the lower left (~3% x, 80% y) to the right edge (~30% y) that the reference doesn't have. The reference's pale blue-grey streaks are in the upper-left (left edge 15-55% y, steeply angled) and in a flatter fan at the bottom right (55-100% x, 65-100% y).
The reference is made of many fine streaks with sharper edges that diverge in a fan: steep at the upper left, flatter at the lower right. Ours has fewer, softer, wider bands with less angular spread.

The middle dark mass in the reference is a diagonal wedge pointing left. It starts at ~30% x, ~50% y and widens up-right to fill the right edge from ~20% to 55% y. Ours is a horizontal, flat-bottomed slab that starts at ~40% x, is much darker and denser, and leaves the upper-right lighter grey.
The top-left dark streak in the reference tilts clearly up to the right (~15% x, 35% y to ~60% x, 10% y) and is a broad soft diagonal. Ours is nearly horizontal and thinner, at 5-60% x, 15-25% y.

The reference's left half is mottled mid/light grey with soft darker diagonal shading (left edge 20-50% y, a lighter wisp around 60-70% y). Ours is a flat, uniform pale grey from the left edge to ~40% x.

The reference's light area is a broad cream/white wash covering most of the top ~25% (strongest at the top right) and flowing down-left as a diffuse, wide band. Ours has a narrow, sharply defined cream stripe from the top-right to the bottom-left, with an orange-tan top-left corner beside it.

Ours adds parallel red-orange streak bands on both sides of the cream stripe (left at 0-20% x, 30-55% y, and right before the dark corner) that the reference doesn't have. The reference's left side is soft amber-orange with fine streak texture.

The reference's bottom-left is a warm brownish-grey smoky zone spanning 0-40% x, 65-100% y with fine diagonal streaks. Ours is a narrower grey-brown band. Our dark bottom-right corner also has a bright red rim, which the reference doesn't.

The reference's red bottom third is made of distinct flame/petal tongues: soft-edged red shapes with pointed tips curving upward and to the left, starting around 60-65% y. Ours has straight, near-vertical red streak lines that run up into the middle and top of the frame, with no petal shapes.

The dark green mass in the reference is a large, rounded, soft-edged blob in the top-left (0-35% x, 0-45% y) with a curved lower boundary. Ours is a vertical dark strip broken into streaks, extending down to ~45% y as a column.

The reference's centre is a bright peach/cream glow (~30-75% x, 25-60% y) with a yellow highlight near 60% x, 55% y, and the right side is solid orange. Ours has repeating thin vertical red lines through the centre and right that break up that glow.
The reference's dark green is a large, very dark (near-black green) mass in the bottom left (0-40% x, 55-100% y). Ours is a lighter, smaller green zone split into many parallel green streaks.

Ours repeats evenly spaced parallel green streaks across the whole lower-right half. The reference has a few green streaks fanning from the bottom-centre, and its bottom-right (70-100% x, 60-100% y) is mostly coral/pink with only faint green.

The reference has bright pinkish-white highlight streaks in the bottom-centre (35-55% x, 70-100% y), a crisper single dark hairline at 60-70% x, 15-35% y, and a yellow-green tint in the top-left corner. Ours has none of these highlights and no yellow-green corner.
The pale blue-grey top-left wedge in the reference blends into orange through a soft gradient. Ours has a visible yellow/pink rainbow fringe line along that edge that the reference doesn't have.

The reference has a distinct light pink highlight band running diagonally through the lower right (from ~45% x at the bottom up to ~75% x at the top), plus a pink-white streak at ~25-40% x, 55-100% y. Our lower half is a fairly uniform coral-red, without those pink highlights.
The reference's yellow is a pale buttery highlight at ~25-55% x, 0-25% y. Ours is a broader, more saturated peach-apricot glow, and the reference's top-right is more pink-beige than ours.

The reference's top-left dark mauve area is several soft, broken streaks with lighter pink gaps between them (x 5-80%, y 5-40%). Ours is one solid, hard-edged dark mauve wedge with a clean straight lower boundary.

The reference has a distinct saturated magenta streak in the lower right (45-100% x, 65-90% y), set apart by lighter pink above it. Our lower half is a uniform pink-magenta gradient with no separate streak.
The reference's bottom-left corner turns lavender/periwinkle blue (0-30% x, 85-100% y), and the top edge has bluish-purple tints near 60-100% x. Ours stays pink/magenta in those places.

The reference burst floats on a pale blue-grey background that shows at the top-left corner, as a notch on the left edge (~55-75% y), down the whole right edge, and in the bottom-left corner. Ours fills the left and bottom edges with red/orange, so the background shows only in the top-right corner.

The reference is a chaotic, chunky motion blur: lumpy red blobs with pink-white and yellow patches, streaks angled down-left, and two lobes split by the left notch. Ours is a clean, ordered fan of smooth straight bands converging toward the right-middle edge.

The reference's yellow-orange sits in the lower-left lobe (5-40% x, 65-100% y) and in small patches in the upper-centre. Ours has a long, broad yellow band running across the bottom-left and centre (0-60% x, 55-80% y).
